title.en: Approved Qualifications for Veterinary Surgeons (Consolidation) Notification

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 1 条。

text.en:
Poisons Act
(CHAPTER 234, Definition of “Veterinary Surgeon” in Section 2)
Approved Qualifications for
Veterinary Surgeons (Consolidation)
Notification
N 2
G.N. No. S 120/1958
REVISED EDITION 1999
(1st January 1999)
The Minister for Health has approved the following diplomas and degrees as qualifications for veterinary surgeons within the meaning of the Poisons Act:
(a)the Veterinary Degree of the University of Brisbane;
[S 120/58 — 30.5.58]
(b)the Veterinary Degree of the University of Sydney;
(c)the Veterinary Degree of the University of Pretoria;
(d)the Veterinary Degree of the University of Toronto;
(e)the East Pakistan College of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry; and
[1182/62 — 1.6.62]
(f)the Bachelor of Veterinary Science Degree (B.VSc.) of the University of Ceylon.
[Sp. S 11/63 — 4.10.63]
